info.name: MPL Analytic API - Automation Test Suite
info.description:
Postman Collection komprehensif untuk pengujian seluruh endpoint backend MPL Analytic.

Memenuhi kriteria kelengkapan pengujian:
- Seluruh endpoint RESTful (Dashboard, Meta, Heroes, Players, Matches, Tournaments, Games, Items)
- Kondisi Sukses (200 OK / Response Valid)
- Semua Kondisi Error per Endpoint (400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, 405 Method Not Allowed, 501 Not Implemented)
- Pengujian Keamanan & Negatif (SQL Injection, XSS, Path Traversal, Unsupported Methods)

Environment Base URL:
- Laragon / Apache: http://127.0.0.1/manajemen-proyek-kelompok-4/mpl-analytic/public
- PHP Built-in Server: http://localhost:8000
- VirtualHost: http://manajemen-proyek-kelompok-4.test
